description: Fetch the full detail for a single Cronus UI component or block by name: its source file(s) (path + content), its npm `dependencies`, its `registryDependencies` (other registry items it needs), and the `npx cronus-ui add <name>` install command. Works for both components and blocks.

name.description: The exact registry item name, e.g. 'button', 'data-table', or 'pricing'.

name: get_component
title: Get a Cronus UI component or block
